facts.business: The company manufactures electronic components such as Reed Switches, Proximity Sensors, and Ball Switches.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material uncertainty related to Going Concern (accumulated losses of Rs. 832.62 Lakhs eroding net worth, current liabilities exceeding current assets by Rs. 179.08 Lakhs); Material Change in Shareholding post Balance Sheet Date (Touristas Horizons and BBU Enterprises acquired ~20.64% shareholding on 14th May 2026); Advance Against Transfer of Business Undertaking under BTA (received INR 300 Lakhs from Canolli Manufacturing, total consideration INR 425 Lakhs); Exceptional Items (write back of credit/debit balances with Group Companies amounting to INR 1610.25 Lakhs).

key_risks: Inability to pass on increased raw material costs (Gold, Rhodium) to customers
Accumulated losses leading to complete erosion of net worth (Rs. 832.62 Lakhs)
Current liabilities exceeding current assets (Rs. 179.08 Lakhs)
Material uncertainty regarding ability to continue as a going concern
Dependence on group company transactions and write-backs
facts.related_party_note: Exceptional items include write back of credit and debit balances in respect of purchase of raw materials, consumables etc payable to Group Companies and towards sales to Group Companies amounting to INR 1610.25 Lakhs, approved by Board on May 25, 2026. Management confirms no interest/penal charge by Group Company on such write back.
